svg.title: rEach and Teach: the privacy map
svg.desc: Three columns on the student's computer: what is never recorded, what stays on the computer and what leaves for the course server. Teach receives only the third column and keeps no transcript.
svg.text: What is never recorded, what never leaves and the short list of what the course server receives.
Not written to disk. Not sent
Private memory of how the student works
The student can see it, export it
and erase it. The profile is
shared only inside a help request
only after the student says yes
the questions only the student can answer
a summary the student agrees to send
no files, nothing from the conversation
where it failed, never what was typed
course server · private to the instructors
what the student said yes to
What the student types goes to the AI provider they chose, as any
chat does, under that provider's policy.
Ask rEach what it remembers, or run reach memory list. reach
Nothing rEach saves changes a grade. The grade of record is kept
